# Fornax Labs — full content

> Fornax Labs is an agentic AI platform for advisory and professional firms: mutual fund distributors, insurance brokers, CA and tax firms, and law firms. Agents pick up client requests from the channels a firm already uses (email, WhatsApp, web forms and business tools), work out what is needed, do the routine work, and bring in a person for anything sensitive. Every run is tracked end to end. Sugamkar is the first product built on the platform.

## The platform

Every advisory firm runs on client requests: an SIP change, a policy renewal, a tax notice, a new matter. Fornax agents handle that loop wherever the work comes from, and hand people only the decisions that need them.

- Comes in from: email, WhatsApp, web forms, and your tools and APIs.
- Fornax agents: read and understand the request, decide what kind of work it is, do the routine steps, and ask a person when it matters.
- Ends up as: tasks with an assignee, summaries and reports, updates in your tools, and approved replies.

Channel status: email is live; WhatsApp and web forms are rolling out with pilot customers; other channels on request.

## Use cases

Each playbook teaches the platform the requests, documents and deadlines of one kind of firm, so agents are useful from day one.

1. Mutual fund distributors and wealth advisors (pilots open, powered by Sugamkar): SIP changes, redemptions and switches captured with folio details; KYC, nominee and address updates tracked to completion; statement and capital gains requests sent on time; complaints flagged high priority and escalated first.
2. Insurance brokers and agents (coming next): new quote requests captured with the details needed; renewal reminders drafted well before the due date; claim intimations tracked from first notice to settlement; endorsements and policy document requests routed to the right person.
3. CA and tax firms (coming next): GST and income tax filing requests sorted by client; tax notices logged with response due dates; document collection with automatic reminders; fee follow-ups and payment reminders, with approval.
4. Law firms and legal practices (coming next): new matter enquiries captured with a conflict-check task; hearing and court date updates routed to the right associate; document requests and filings tracked to completion; client update requests and fee follow-ups.

## How it works

1. Pick a playbook for your industry and the work that eats your week.
2. Connect your channels: email, WhatsApp, forms and the systems you already use. Set the rules and limits.
3. Deploy with guardrails: require approvals for sensitive steps and let the agent handle the rest.
4. Track and improve: watch every run, review outcomes and refine the agent over time.

## Make it yours: rules, routing and approvals

- Custom rules: conditions on anything the agent understands, such as the kind of request, an amount, the client, the channel or the time of day.
- Routing: send work to a person, a team or round robin, by skill, workload or client; reassign in one click.
- Approval flows: choose which actions need sign-off, from whom and in what order; add a second approver above a limit you set.
- Extend any playbook: add your own kinds of request and decide what happens with each.

Example rule: when a client message arrives on email or WhatsApp, if it is a redemption over ₹1,00,000, create a high-priority task routed round robin to the Operations team, and require Branch manager sign-off on any reply; otherwise assign it to a named person at normal priority.

## Agent tracking

Every step, tool call and decision is logged and searchable. Sensitive actions are routed to the right person for approval before they happen. Time saved, success rate and spend are shown per agent. Example run: an insurance renewal-reminder agent finds 31 policies due in 30 days, drafts the reminders, holds a high-value fleet policy for branch manager approval, then sends and logs everything.

## Sugamkar

Sugamkar is an agent for advisors, distributors and service firms. Clients write in on email, WhatsApp and web forms; Sugamkar reads every message, recognises what each request is, and puts the work that needs a person on one list (Today) with an assignee and a status.

What each message becomes:
1. Personally identifiable information (PII) and sensitive personal information (SPI) are masked with typed placeholders such as [NAME_1] before any AI processing.
2. The request is recognised as a kind from the firm's playbook (for example SIP changes, Redemptions, KYC updates, Nominee changes, Statement requests or Complaints), with a confidence score. Messages it is unsure about go to a Review list for one-click sorting.
3. A task is created with the customer, matched details from the client record (such as folio, phone and email), a priority, an assignee and a suggested next step. Full details are shown only inside the firm's workspace.

Playbooks: mutual fund distributors (available for pilots); insurance brokers, CA and tax firms, and law firms (coming next). Other advisory and professional firms, such as wealth managers, tax consultants and company secretaries, can ask about fit.

Principles: private by design; the firm stays in control (nothing is sent to a client without approval); a team view for owners with filtering and reassignment; summaries, not investment advice.

Pilot: Fornax Labs is onboarding a small group of distributors and advisory firms. Apply at https://fornaxlabs.xyz/site/sugamkar#pilot. Fornax Labs replies within one business day, holds a 30-minute call, then sets up the firm's playbook and connects the first channel.

## FAQ — Fornax Labs

### What is Fornax Labs?

Fornax Labs is an agentic AI platform for advisory and professional firms: mutual fund distributors, insurance brokers, CA and tax firms, and law firms. Our agents pick up client requests from email, WhatsApp and web forms, work out what is needed, do the routine work, and bring in a person for anything sensitive. Every run is tracked end to end.

### What is agent orchestration?

Agent orchestration is the work of running AI agents reliably inside a business: connecting them to the right channels, tools and data, sequencing their steps, routing sensitive actions to a person for approval, and recording every run so you can see what happened and what it cost. Fornax Labs handles that layer so teams get working agents rather than a blank canvas.

### Which channels and tools do Fornax agents work with?

Agents take work in from email, WhatsApp, web forms and the systems your firm already uses, such as practice-management software, CRMs and back-office platforms. Email is live today, and WhatsApp and further channels are rolling out with our pilot customers.

### What kinds of work can Fornax agents do?

Each industry has a ready-made playbook. For fund distributors: SIP changes, redemptions, KYC and nominee updates, statements and complaints. For insurance brokers: quotes, renewals, claims and endorsements. For CA and tax firms: filing requests, tax notices, document collection and fee follow-ups. For law firms: new matter intake, hearing updates, document requests and client updates. New kinds of request can be added to any playbook.

### What is Sugamkar?

Sugamkar is the first product on the Fornax platform. It reads client messages from email, WhatsApp and other channels, recognises what each request is, and turns it into a tracked task on one worklist. It is open for pilots with mutual fund distributors.

### How do approvals and tracking work?

Sensitive steps, such as sending a reply to a client or changing a record, are routed to the right person for approval before they happen. Every step, tool call and decision is logged and searchable, and each agent shows time saved, success rate and spend.

### Can I customise rules, routing and approvals?

Yes. You set the conditions an agent acts on, such as the kind of request, an amount, the client or the channel. You decide where the work goes: a person, a team or round robin. And you choose which actions need approval, from whom and above what limit. No code required.

### Do I need an engineering team to use Fornax?

No. You start from a ready-made playbook for your industry, connect your channels and tools, and set the rules and limits. Fornax Labs is built for operators and small teams, not developers.

### How do I get started with Fornax Labs?

Tell us the work that takes up your team's week through the contact form on fornaxlabs.xyz, book a call, or email sales@fornaxlabs.xyz. We'll show you the agent that handles it.

## FAQ — Sugamkar

### Which channels does Sugamkar work with?

Email is live today. WhatsApp Business and web forms are rolling out with our pilot firms, and other channels can be added on request. Every channel lands on the same Today list.

### Will Sugamkar reply to my clients on its own?

No. Sugamkar sorts, summarises and creates work for your team. Any reply it prepares, by email or WhatsApp, waits for a person to approve it.

### What happens to my clients' personal data?

Sugamkar detects personally identifiable information (PII) and sensitive personal information (SPI) in every message, whichever channel it came from, and replaces it with placeholders before any AI processing. That covers identifiers such as government ID and tax numbers, financial account numbers, phone numbers and email addresses. The originals are restored only inside your workspace.

### What if it gets a message wrong?

When Sugamkar isn't confident, it puts the message on your Today list and asks you to choose. One click files it correctly, starts the right follow-up, and Sugamkar learns from your choice for next time.

### Can I decide who gets which requests?

Yes. Set your own rules: route each kind of request to a person, a team or round robin, raise the priority above an amount you choose, and require a manager's approval before anything goes back to a client. Reassign any task in one click.

### Do I need to change how my team works?

No new inbox, number or app for your clients. Your team opens one list each morning instead of digging through mail and chats.

### How much does it cost?

Pricing is per connected channel. Early pilot firms get preferential pricing in return for feedback. Get in touch for details.
